context: Length-bounded string field (3 to 20) that also enforces a character whitelist. Predicted baseline failure: the agent covers a short name and a long name but not the inside-adjacent lengths (4 and 19), and builds its boundary strings from arbitrary or randomised characters - which can silently trip the whitelist rule, so a length test fails for a character reason and the diagnosis points at the wrong rule. The skill's value is the six-point set on length plus a fixed alphabet that isolates the length rule from the character rule.

checklist.name: Test file created
checklist.description: A file src/username.test.js exists and contains at least one test.

checklist.name: Lower length bound covered on all three points
checklist.description: Lengths 2 (TOO_SHORT), 3 (accepted), and 4 (accepted) are each exercised. Missing the length-4 point caps this at half; missing two of the three scores zero.

checklist.name: Upper length bound covered on all three points
checklist.description: Lengths 19 (accepted), 20 (accepted), and 21 (TOO_LONG) are each exercised. Missing the length-19 point caps this at half; missing two of the three scores zero.

checklist.name: Length inputs use only whitelist-legal characters
checklist.description: MUST NOT let the character rule contaminate the length cases. Every string used to probe a length boundary is built from characters the whitelist allows, so a TOO_SHORT or TOO_LONG assertion can only fail for a length reason. A length probe containing an uppercase letter, space, hyphen, or punctuation scores zero on this criterion.

checklist.name: Inputs are deterministic
checklist.description: MUST NOT. Boundary strings are fixed literals or built by a deterministic repeat such as 'a'.repeat(21) - not drawn from Math.random or an unseeded generator. Any randomly generated input scores zero here.

checklist.name: Character rule covered separately
checklist.description: At least one case exercises BAD_CHARS using a string of legal length, keeping the character rule independent of the length rule. A suite that only reaches BAD_CHARS through a string that is also the wrong length scores zero on this criterion.

checklist.name: Specific rejection codes asserted
checklist.description: Failing cases assert the exact code - TOO_SHORT, TOO_LONG, BAD_CHARS, NOT_STRING - rather than only that ok is false. Asserting only falsiness scores zero here.
